title.narrative: Green Economy Programme in the Philippines

description.narrative: Increased engagement of the private and financial sectors, inclusive of gender and youth, in the Philippines's green and circular economy

The proposed intervention will support the Philippines’ inclusive and green recovery by unlocking the potential, the delivery and the operationalization of the circular economy via(i) establishing a central-Government level Policy Dialogue Forum mobilizing EU expertise to facilitate policy formulation, improve city to city collaboration through supporting the development of a National Circular Economy Strategy and Roadmap and to apply the dialogue’s outcome;(ii) working with local government units where the EU expertise will support to define and implement policies on circular economy and climate change, outreach and support of local business and civil society, including support to less advanced LGUs; and(iii) creating better conditions for private sector investment by supporting business driven waste reduction strategies and circular solutions in the production process.The below is thetentative structure of the programme, determined by the EU Delegation to the Philippines, thus GGGI is targeting to implementSpecific Objective1.Specific Objective 1 (National): The widespread, inefficient plastic economy and dysfunctional waste management tackled with measurable reduction of plastic waste and marine litter, while generating co-benefits.Indirect management with an "International Organisation" (Euro 10m)Specific Objective 2 (Provincial): Selected local government units, at city/municipality level and in clusters thereof, transformed from managers of waste to drivers of a circular economy transition and innovation, in collaboration with the private sector.Indirect management with an "MS (member state) Organisation" (Euro 24m)Specific Objective 3 (Private sector): Enabling the involvement of the private sector in the innovation and investment of waste reduction solutions as well as business models conducive of a circular plastics economy (Euro 15m).Indirect management with a "European Lead Finance Institution" (Euro 15m)

participating-org.narrative: European Union (EU): Delegation to the Philippines
